title: TNS x EDP2 Explorer: bulk download

columns.name: TNS name without prefix; the join key for photometry.csv.gz
columns.survey_region: WFD, or the LSST Deep Drilling Field covering the object (positional)
columns.debass: DEBASS follow-up status: FINISHED or YES (null if not a target)
columns.rubin_alert_ids: Rubin alert-stream diaObjectIds (Fink LSST, <= 2"), comma separated. Read as strings
columns.rubin_first: rubin: TNS discovery made in Rubin data (Rubin group, an LSST internal name, or the first Rubin alert itself); earlier/later: first positive Rubin alert detection before/after TNS discovery; none: no alert detection; pre: discovered before the alert stream
columns.lead_alert_days: TNS discovery MJD minus first positive Rubin alert detection MJD (> 0: Rubin earlier)
columns.n_tns_spectra: number of spectra reported to TNS
columns.n_lsstcam_pointings: Rubin DP2 visit centres within 2.1 deg (public pointing metadata)
columns.n_lsst_alert: measurements from LSST alerts (Fink) (upper limits excluded)
columns.n_lsst_alert_fp: measurements from LSST alert forced (Fink) (upper limits excluded)
columns.n_ztf: measurements from ZTF alerts (ALeRCE) (upper limits excluded)
columns.n_ztf_fp: measurements from ZTF forced (ALeRCE) (upper limits excluded)
columns.n_tns: measurements from TNS reported (upper limits excluded)

columns.name: TNS name without prefix (catalog.csv `name`)
columns.mjd: MJD (TAI for Rubin, as given by the source otherwise)
columns.flux_njy: flux in nJy (AB zero point 31.4: mag = 31.4 - 2.5 log10 flux)
columns.lim_mag: limiting AB mag for upper limits

columns.name: TNS name without prefix
columns.object_id: survey object ID (ZTF oid or Rubin alert diaObjectId; read as string)
columns.n_det: detection number (positive detections, metaDEBASS count; for Rubin IDs metaDEBASS did not score, the alert number)
columns.call: what the classifier says at this detection: SN Ia, SN (not Ia), SN (subtype not given), not SN, not Ia
columns.score: the classifier's own score for its call (metaDEBASS: P(SN-like))
columns.label: native output, e.g. CATS class and score, stamp top class, Sherlock context
